prior_results_already_seen: P4 event medians and ordinary same-time baseline medians (docs/audit/live_archive_price_oi_p4_followup_v0/)
question: Does the OI-contraction component of PRICE_OI_CONTRACTION add forward realized-range information beyond the extreme, persistent recent price move that already defines the event?

data_scope.source: Signalbot live archive, source='live', BTCUSDT perp, binance/bybit/okx

event_group_a.lifecycle: current beta.detector.step_episode; anchor = triggered_at (close of the triggering 5m bucket)

control_group_b.price_side_predicate: current semantic_rule evaluated with only the OI rank neutralised; identical price metric, operator, threshold, family usability and price maturity
control_group_b.oi_requirement: OI percentile present, value present, tier mature, and rank >= oi_control_rank_min
control_group_b.lifecycle: same current step_episode and lifecycle thresholds as the family; anchor = triggered_at

reference_price: beta.state_tape.reference_price over the reconstructed exchange features of the triggering bucket

outcome.per_event_endpoint: d_e = ln(R_e) - mean over matched controls c of ln(R_c)
outcome.family_statistic: median of d_e over matched events

matched: log_abs_trigger_price_move: ln|price_move_pct_median| of the triggering bucket
covariates.time_basis: UTC hour and weekday of the triggering bucket start

matching.scale: population SD of each matched covariate over eligible A union eligible B of the family

balance_gate.zero_scale_rule: pass only if the mean difference is exactly 0

placebo.design: B-vs-B: every eligible B anchor is a pseudo-event matched to the other eligible B anchors (itself excluded) with the same distance, caliper and k

declustering.cluster_rule: matched events sorted by anchor; a new cluster starts when the gap to the previous matched event anchor exceeds 4h
declustering.sensitivity: median d(4h) over the first event of each cluster

family_verdict_order: OI_INCREMENTAL_SIGNAL_PILOT_SURVIVES if median d(4h) >= ln(1.25) and first-per-cluster median d(4h) >= ln(1.25)
